Inherited dental enamel hypomaturation and hypomineralization; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Marfanoid skeletal and aortic/valvular abnormalities; lens subluxation is a major syndromic feature, frequency unspecified. Situs inversus alone does not imply organ injury.
Neoplasm of the rete ovarii, a reproductive structure; no endocrine function or other covered organ is implicated.
